en.title: Lexicographically Smallest Rearrangement of a Palindromic Password
en.description:
The input is guaranteed to be a lowercase palindrome. Rearrange all of its characters to get the lexicographically smallest password that is still a palindrome.

The standard I/O and the solution were written independently by this site; ranges marked as this site's are not the original source constraints.
en.input: One line with a lowercase palindrome of length 1..100000.
en.output: Output the lexicographically smallest palindrome after rearrangement.
en.explanation: Example 1: the left half is ab and the middle is b, which mirrors to abbba. Example 2: the left half is xy, giving xyyx. Example 3: the sides can only be d and the middle e, so it stays ded.
hints: Build the left half from half of each letter in ascending order, put the character with an odd count in the middle, and make the right half the reverse of the left half.
